name: Michelle Zhao
title: Assistant Professor of Computer Science
department: Computer Science, Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering; Reliable Interactive Autonomy Lab
fitReason: Direct CS/embodied-AI fit: uncertainty calibration, active human feedback, imitation learning and preference alignment. Her new independent RIA Lab launched in August 2026; the verified robot experiments are prior CMU work, not proof of current IU hardware access.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full ICLR2025 ConformalDAgger paper deploys a visual CNN diffusion policy on an actual seven-DoF arm for sponge wiping. Fifty initial human demonstrations are followed by interactive physical rollouts with Meta Quest3 corrections; conformal intervals adapt during execution to detect a switch from straight-line to zigzag teaching, while policy retraining occurs after the rollout collection. It demonstrates learned physical action and feedback queries, but the initial study is at CMU. No named robot model or new IU hardware deployment is inferred. Simulation-only benchmarks in the same paper are kept separate.

shortVisit.summary: The live RIA Lab join page recruits PhD students through degree admission, and explicitly limits its master’s/undergraduate invitation to people already at Indiana University. Its broad homepage recruiting wording does not establish a short external-master visit. Summer 2027 capacity, an eight-week project, funding and remote work are unknown.

Reuse the existing Indiana institutional review: Student Intern is for eligible full-time overseas-degree students, with host training plan, 32-hour minimum and departmental processing at least three months before arrival. Mentor acceptance is separate.

The earlier official Student Intern page lists $1,200/month support, to be rechecked for 2027. Personal/external funding explicitly described for Research Scholar/Professor must not be automatically transferred to Student Intern.
The current local-master’s recruitment page gives no external visitor duration, stipend, fully personal-funding route or remote arrangement.
September 2026 lab news names two workshop acceptances, but their full texts were not verified; they are not used to claim new hardware experiments or boost freshness beyond the inspected2025 work.

The homepage/research page inconsistently labels Conformalized Teleoperation as RSS2025 while the detailed publication list says RSS2024. The selected physical source is the separate unambiguous ICLR2025 ConformalDAgger paper.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.
